column1: 🔗 Field structure per PDD Section D01. RACSI columns (R/A/C/S/I) use the Section 5.1 role legend: ES=Executive Sponsor, CM=Change Manager, PM=Program/Project Manager, FPO=Functional Process Owner, ITL=IT/Technical Lead, SUP=Frontline Supervisor, EU=End User. Associated_Module references D26; Tier_Level values are defined in D26. Macro-level SIPOC is already fully stored per row (Inputs_Suppliers=S, Inputs=I, Macro_Process_Detailed_Description=P, Outputs=O, Beneficiaries=C) and macro-level RACSI is already stored as 5 discrete columns — both satisfy Functional Spec Section 3.6/Module 19's native-storage requirement without further schema change. Org_Specific_Extension_Allowed (NEW) supports Module 19's 11th, organization-specific macro process: all 10 canonical processes are platform-seeded (No); an Organization Admin may add exactly one additional org-specific process by cloning this row structure with Org_Specific_Extension_Allowed = Yes.
